description: This file implements a low-level memory allocator using skiplist data structures, platform-specific memory mapping, and arena management. It is part of the Abseil C++ library's internal base namespace, providing functions for allocating and freeing memory blocks with detailed control over memory arenas.

classes.name: LowLevelAlloc::Arena
classes.description: Represents a memory arena used by the low-level allocator, managing free blocks, allocation counts, and platform-specific memory mappings.

classes.name: absl::base_internal::ArenaLock
classes.description: A scoped lock class for synchronizing access to an Arena's data structures.

methods.name: LowLevelAlloc::Arena::Arena
methods.description: Constructor initializing an arena with specific flags and platform parameters.

methods.name: LowLevelAlloc::NewArena
methods.description: Creates a new memory arena with specified flags, possibly unhooked or async-signal safe.

methods.name: LowLevelAlloc::DeleteArena
methods.description: Deletes a memory arena, freeing all associated memory blocks if the arena is empty.

methods.name: LowLevelAlloc::DefaultArena
methods.description: Returns the default global memory arena used by the allocator.
